课程简介（中文）

本课程介绍中国尤其是上海在文化教育领域的国际交流合作历史和现状，通过上海在教育、音乐、戏剧、电影和文学方面的国际化路线和交流实践，展示中国如何在与世界联结和对话中探索自己的现代化道路，在改革开放中推动自身的文化教育发展，提升自己的国际形象并积极参与塑造一个多元、和平、共同繁荣的世界。

课程简介（英文）

This course explores the history and current landscape of international exchange and cooperation in culture and education of China and, in particular, the city of Shanghai. Through an in-depth look at Shanghai’s global engagement in education, music, theater, film, and literature, the course reveals how China has forged its own path to modernization by connecting and dialoguing with the world. It examines how, in the context of Reform and Opening up, China has advanced its cultural and educational development, enhanced its international image, and actively contributed to shaping a diverse, peaceful, and prosperous world.

教学目标

This international course, designed specifically for students from around the world, explores the active role of Chinese and foreign cultural exchange institutions in promoting civilizational dialogue and cultural interaction. It will examine how China and the world engage in equal-footed dialogue and mutually beneficial cooperation, and how China’s policy of opening up serves as a driving force behind Chinese-style modernization as well as an effective pathway for the international dissemination of Chinese culture.

 

By the end of the course, students will enhance their cognitive understanding and practical skills in fostering friendly China-foreign exchanges, cross-cultural dialogue, and intercultural communication.

教学方式

This course combines theoretical learning with hands-on practice. Students will engage in field visits and research activities in Shanghai, followed by in-class presentations, allowing students to experience firsthand the dynamic landscape of international cultural exchange in the city. Through this process, you will develop an up-to-date understanding of current international cooperation in Chinese culture and education.

 

Course Organization:

Instructor-led guidance and framing + Student-led fieldwork and independent research outside class + In-class presentations by students + Instructor-facilitated discussions and constructive feedback.

教学内容与进度安排

Course Schedule: China and the World

Week 1 – Course Introduction

Overview of course content and structure. Group discussion on globalization and cultural diversity. Instructor-led lecture. No assignment.

Week 2 – China Goes Global (1)

Understanding the history of China's connection with the world. Group discussion. Reading assignment.

Week 3 – China Goes Global (2)

Understanding China's reform and opening-up policy. Group discussion. Reading assignment.

Week 4 – China Goes Global (3)

Understanding China's current internationalization process. Group discussion. Film viewing assignment.

Week 5 – Contemporary China's Cultural and Educational Cooperation Mechanisms

Understanding the role and significance of international cooperation. Group discussion.

Week 6 – Cultural and Educational Cooperation in Shanghai as a Global City

Understanding Shanghai's unique role. Group discussion.

Practical Fieldwork (Weeks 7–12)
